The '''Dark Talisman''' can be found in a chest in the [[Mutant Bug Lair]]. Obtaining it is part of the [[Quests#Dark Talisman|Dark Talisman quest]]. It is used to open the passage at the northeast end of the [[Railroad]].

Once obtained, it can be found in the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab in [[the Player]]'s Menu. Oddly enough, it remains there even after using it.

==History==
{{History|1.1|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.6|Now located in the new Special Items & Powers tab instead of the player's wallet.}}
